# ForgeX runtime defaults

Generated by scripts/generate-engine-contracts.py from host contracts.

| Boundary | Default seconds |
| --- | ---: |
| Provider connect | 10 |
| Provider first event | 120 |
| Provider idle | 60 |
| Provider total | 300 |
| Provider write | 30 |
| Provider pool | 5 |
| Agent turn | 180 |
| Review unit | 60 |
| Generation turn maximum | 300 |
| Model repair window | 120 |

Job profiles, recovery limits, renderer defaults and failure codes: [runtime-policy.generated.json](runtime-policy.generated.json).

These are defaults. Effective phase and job deadlines can shorten an attempt. A local deadline is never a provider outage.
